title: tab/dialogAnswer
description: Shell-to-engine notification: the answer to a tab/dialog or tab/permission prompt (the person's, from the shell's dialog, or an agent's eludite.browser.dialog). `accept` true is OK (alert, confirm, prompt: JsDialogCallback::Continue(true, text); beforeunload: leave; file: the chosen `files`; auth: `username` and `password`; a permission prompt: allow); false is Cancel (dismiss, stay, no files, no credentials, deny). An answer for a dialog that is gone is ignored. tab/dialogClosed follows.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

text.description: `prompt`: the text entered (default: the dialog's defaultText).
